d: Real Madrid's global image has come under scrutiny following Kylian Mbappe's controversial comments about a meme featuring former Chinese leader Mao Zedong. At a time when the La Liga giants are dealing with questions about their international reputation, Rafael Nadal's entry into the club has attracted particular interest. Nadal enjoys a strong relationship with Chinese tennis fans, dating back to his historic gold medal at the 2008 Beijing Olympics.
